# Mr Sewing Fashion

> Mr Sewing is a bespoke, made-to-order tailoring business in Kigali, Rwanda. This guide links to public website information; it does not advertise an automated booking API or agent-operated services.

## Discover the brand

- [Homepage](/): Bespoke fashion and garment-care information.
- [About Mr Sewing](/about/): The existing brand story and official logo.
- [Contact and locations](/contact/): Confirm visiting and appointment arrangements.
- [Our Work](/our-work/): Owner-authorised photographs of completed garments with garment-focused editorial descriptions, without invented customer histories or testimonials.

## Tailoring services

- [Services overview](/services/): Choose a dedicated service.
- [Custom Tailoring](/services/custom-tailoring/): Men's and women's tailoring, references, materials, measurements and fittings.
- [Wedding and Civil Wedding Tailoring](/services/wedding-tailoring/): Discuss ceremony requirements and confirm feasibility.
- [Graduation Tailoring](/services/graduation-tailoring/): Discuss a graduation outfit and fitting arrangements.
- [Mobile Fitting](/services/mobile-fitting/): Request a customer-location fitting in Kigali; coverage, charges and availability require confirmation.
- [Alterations and Refinements](/services/alterations/): Request a garment assessment and quote.
- [Express Tailoring](/services/express-tailoring/): Urgent requests need explicit capacity, fee and deadline confirmation.
- [Our process](/our-process/): References, design agreement, production planning, fitting and handover.
- [Measurements and fittings](/made-to-measure/): How workshop and mobile fitting relate to a tailoring order.

## Garment care

- [Mr Sewing Garment Care](/services/garment-care/): A specialised care-information and enquiry section. Specific treatments are advertised only when confirmed.
- [Care-service information](/services/garment-care/services/): Garment suitability and the enquiry process.
- [Care quotes and planning](/services/garment-care/planning/): Pricing, turnaround and pickup/delivery status. No unapproved rates or completion times are published.

## Design inspiration and help

- [All Collections](/collections/): The preserved photographic inspiration showroom and stable garment links.
- [Men's collection](/mensuits/): Existing men's design inspiration.
- [Women's collection](/womensuits/): Existing women's design inspiration.
- [Existing FAQs](/faq/): Current published information; updates are deferred.
- [Measurement guide](/measurements/): Existing measurement guidance.

## Official policies

- [Terms and Conditions](/terms-and-conditions/)
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy-policy/)
- [Refund Policy](/refund-policy/)

FAQs are informational and do not replace official policy documents. Prices, timing, payments, visit coverage and service availability must be confirmed where not approved for publication. Enquiry links do not confirm an appointment or order.
